title: Shared Responsibility Across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS
description: Interactive SVG infographic comparing On-Prem, IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS as nine-layer stacks colored by who is responsible, showing that data, identity, and configuration always stay with the customer.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Compare how responsibility for each layer of the stack shifts across On-Prem, IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS.
Identify which layers the provider takes over as the service model moves up the stack.
Explain why data, identity, and configuration always remain the customer's responsibility.
educational.prerequisites: Awareness of the difference between on-premises infrastructure and cloud services.

pedagogical.assessment: Discussion questions in the lesson plan ask students to place a real responsibility (e.g., guest-OS patching) in the correct column and to reason about the always-customer layers.
misconceptionsAddressed: Assuming SaaS means the customer has no security responsibilities.
Believing the cloud provider configures security or protects customer data by default.
